title: Keep every plan artifact parseable

facts.note: The set of in-scope files is enumerable from the repository tree at any time, whether or not the files were changed.
Parse failures are reported by the planner_plan_integrity validator over the whole plan/ tree; a finding is one occasion to apply the rule, not a precondition.

fires: The repository contains any .yaml, .yml or .json file under plan/ (plans, wagons, WMBTs, acceptances), whether or not it was touched in the current change.
An unchanged plan artifact under plan/ is unparseable, even before any validator has reported it.
Planner creates or edits a .yaml, .yml or .json file under plan/ (example occasion).
The plan validator reports a parse error for a file under plan/ (example occasion).
doesNotFire: Files under node_modules, dist, build or _generated trees, even if they sit under plan/.
Markdown or other non-YAML/JSON files under plan/.

given: The repository has .yaml, .yml or .json artifacts under plan/ (outside vendored or generated trees).
when: The plan tree is in scope for planning work or validation; this covers every such artifact, changed or unchanged.
then: Every in-scope plan artifact parses as YAML or JSON, including files you did not change.
prefer: Fix the syntax the finding reports.
Treat parsing as the first gate: schema and identity checks only run once the artifact parses.
avoid: Leaving a plan artifact half-written or unparseable and relying on later rules to catch its other defects; they cannot see it.
Silencing the finding by renaming, moving the file into a vendored/generated tree, or changing its extension instead of fixing the syntax.
unless: Vendored and generated trees (node_modules, dist, build, _generated) are never scanned.
why: An artifact that does not parse is invisible to every other rule, so its defects hide behind one error.
evidence: The planner_plan_integrity validator parses every .yaml/.yml/.json under plan/ and reports no atdd-bun.planner.parse finding.
Reviewer can load every in-scope plan artifact with a YAML/JSON parser without error.
verifier_detail: Scan scope: every file under plan/ with extension .yaml, .yml or .json, changed or not; skip any path containing a node_modules, dist, build or _generated directory segment.
Each unparseable file yields one finding reporting the syntax error; severity 3, disposition strict.

Package rule: realized by a package guard (validator planner_plan_integrity) rather than a canonical planner node, but held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.
audit: term package_rule: a rule of this package's own gates (atdd-bun.*), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node; held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.

sharedNodes.text: Strict: the rule fails on every finding; no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.
